newsitem.title: GERMANY: Police evacuate Leipzig station after bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Police evacuate Leipzig station after bomb threat.

text.p: German police evacuated the main train station in Leipzig on Wednesday after five television stations received telephone warnings that a bomb had been planted there.

Police said the television stations had first been told a bomb was due to explode at 4.30 p.m. (1430 GMT) and then at 5.30 p.m. (1530 GMT). A Reuter correspondent at the station reported at 5.15 p.m. that business was as normal.
